faqs.q: What is Vault Electronics?
faqs.a: Vault Electronics is a leading audiovisual (AV) and systems integration company based in Kenya and the UAE, specializing in interactive flat panels, smart classroom setups, boardroom AV integration, digital signage, and workspace technology solutions.

faqs.q: Where are your offices located?
faqs.a: Our main office in Kenya is located at The Stables, Suite 33, Karen Road, Nairobi, with a branch at Nanyuki Business Centre (2nd Floor). We also operate an international office at Flora Square, Deira, Dubai, UAE.

faqs.q: How can I contact Vault Electronics customer support?
faqs.a: You can reach us by phone at +254 763 502654 or +254 722 502654, or email us at info@vaultelectronics.co.ke or info@vaultelectronics.ae.

faqs.q: What industries or sectors do you serve?
faqs.a: We serve educational institutions (K-12 schools, universities), corporate offices, government agencies, healthcare facilities, and religious organizations across East Africa and the Middle East.

faqs.q: Can you list some of your notable clients?
faqs.a: We have partnered with leading organizations including Peponi School, Peponi House, Durham International School, ILRI, and BAT, delivering custom AV and smart classroom solutions.

faqs.q: What core services does Vault Electronics provide?
faqs.a: We offer end-to-end AV solutions including system design, equipment supply, hardware installation, system integration, project management, technical support/maintenance, and staff training.

faqs.q: Do you offer on-site consultation before purchase?
faqs.a: Yes, our AV engineers offer site assessments and consultations to evaluate your room dimensions, lighting, and technical needs before designing a custom setup.

faqs.q: Are your products covered by warranty?
faqs.a: Yes, all Vault Electronics hardware—including Interactive Flat Panels and Digital Podiums—comes with a standard manufacturer warranty (typically 1 to 3 years) covering hardware defects.

faqs.q: How do I request a formal quotation?
faqs.a: You can request a quote by filling out the inquiry form on our website at vaultelectronics.co.ke/contact-us, calling +254 763 502654, or emailing info@vaultelectronics.co.ke.

faqs.q: Do you provide post-installation technical training?
faqs.a: Absolutely. Every installation includes hands-on training for your teachers, IT administrators, or corporate staff to ensure full adoption of the technology.

faqs.q: What sizes do your Interactive Flat Panels (IFPs) come in?
faqs.a: Our Interactive Flat Panels are available in standard sizes of 55" , 65" , 75" , and 86" diagonal displays, suitable for huddle rooms to large auditoriums.

faqs.q: Do Vault Interactive Displays support dual operating systems (Android & Windows)?
faqs.a: Yes, our screens come with built-in Android OS and support optional plug-in OPS (Open Pluggable Specification) Windows modules for seamless switching between environments.

faqs.q: How many simultaneous touch points do your screens support?
faqs.a: Our screens feature ultra-responsive 20-point to 40-point touch technology, allowing multiple students or colleagues to write and annotate simultaneously.

faqs.q: Do I need a projector to use an Interactive Flat Panel?
faqs.a: No, Interactive Flat Panels are self-illuminating LED display panels that replace traditional projectors completely, offering brighter 4K displays without bulb maintenance.

faqs.q: Can I wirelessly mirror my laptop or phone screen to the panel?
faqs.a: Yes, our panels come with built-in wireless screen sharing software supporting AirPlay, Miracast, Chromecast, and dedicated desktop apps for up to 4 devices simultaneously.

faqs.q: What software comes pre-installed on Vault Smart Boards?
faqs.a: They come pre-loaded with an intuitive digital whiteboard app featuring handwriting recognition, shape tools, cloud storage connectivity (Google Drive, OneDrive), and annotation tools over any input source.

faqs.q: Are your interactive displays compatible with Zoom and Microsoft Teams?
faqs.a: Yes, our panels natively support Microsoft Teams, Zoom, Google Meet, and Webex via the built-in system or optional OPS Windows module.

faqs.q: Can Interactive Flat Panels be wall-mounted or placed on a mobile stand?
faqs.a: We provide both robust heavy-duty VESA wall-mount brackets and mobile motorized/manual rolling trolleys for easy movement between rooms.

faqs.q: What resolution do Vault Interactive Flat Panels support?
faqs.a: All current-generation Vault Interactive Flat Panels feature Ultra HD 4K resolution (3840 x 2160) with anti-glare, tempered glass surfaces.

faqs.q: How long do the LED panels last?
faqs.a: Our commercial-grade panels are rated for a backlight lifespan of up to 50,000 hours of continuous operation.

faqs.q: What is a Smart Digital Podium and how is it used?
faqs.a: A Smart Digital Podium is an all-in-one presentation station equipped with an interactive touch screen, built-in PC, gooseneck microphone, amplifier, and port connections to control room displays and audio.

faqs.q: What types of Digital Kiosks does Vault Electronics supply?
faqs.a: We supply indoor floor-standing kiosks, wall-mounted touch displays, double-sided displays, and weather-proof outdoor digital kiosks for wayfinding, ticketing, and information displays.

faqs.q: Can content on your Digital Signage displays be managed remotely?
faqs.a: Yes, our cloud-based Content Management System (CMS) allows you to update image slideshows, video schedules, and announcements across all display networks remotely.

faqs.q: Are Vault Digital Kiosks vandal-resistant?
faqs.a: Yes, our commercial kiosks feature toughened tempered front glass, steel enclosures, and key-locked access doors for security in public locations.

faqs.q: Do your Digital Podiums connect to existing hall sound systems?
faqs.a: Yes, our podiums feature standard audio outputs (XLR and line-out) to interface seamlessly with existing public address (PA) and auditorium sound systems.

faqs.q: What equipment is included in a complete Vault Smart Classroom package?
faqs.a: A standard package includes an Interactive Flat Panel, mobile stand or mount, document camera/visualizer, soundbar/audio system, teacher connection box, and interactive teaching software.

faqs.q: How do you design a corporate boardroom AV solution?
faqs.a: We design boardrooms according to room acoustics and seating layouts, integrating 4K displays, PTZ video conferencing cameras, ceiling array microphones, table connectivity hubs, and centralized touch controllers.

faqs.q: What is a visualizer/document camera used for in a classroom?
faqs.a: A document camera captures high-definition live video of physical documents, textbooks, or 3D specimens and projects them instantly onto the interactive panel for student viewing.

faqs.q: Can you integrate ceiling microphones to cover large conference rooms?
faqs.a: Yes, we install beamforming ceiling microphone arrays that capture clear audio across the entire room while canceling ambient noise and echo.

faqs.q: Do you provide hidden or structured cabling for room setups?
faqs.a: Yes, our installation team ensures clean installations using wall trunking, floor pop-up boxes, and ceiling raceways so no loose wiring is visible.

faqs.q: What is the typical installation timeline for an Interactive Panel?
faqs.a: Standard wall-mount or trolley installation for a single Interactive Panel takes approximately 2 to 4 hours, including cabling and initial software calibration.

faqs.q: How do I log a support request if my display experiences an issue?
faqs.a: You can open a ticket by emailing info@vaultelectronics.co.ke, calling our support line at +254 763 502654, or contacting your designated account manager.

faqs.q: Do you offer Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC)?
faqs.a: Yes, we offer AMC packages that cover periodic hardware checks, software updates, emergency on-site assistance, and replacement loaner units.

faqs.q: How do I clean the screen of my Vault Interactive Flat Panel safely?
faqs.a: Turn off the display and gently wipe the glass using a micro-fiber cloth lightly dampened with water or a 70% isopropyl alcohol solution. Avoid abrasive cleaners or direct spraying.

faqs.q: What happens if an interactive screen needs hardware repair outside warranty?
faqs.a: We maintain an inventory of spare parts and offer paid technician services, board repairs, and panel replacements for out-of-warranty units.

faqs.q: What are Vault Safety Tools?
faqs.a: Vault Safety Tools encompass institutional access control, non-contact thermal screeners, visitor management kiosks, and emergency alert signaling systems designed for school and workplace safety.

faqs.q: Can Vault Visitor Management Kiosks print guest badges?
faqs.a: Yes, our visitor management kiosks feature integrated badge printers, barcode/QR scanners, and ID card capture tools.

faqs.q: Are safety management systems compatible with existing school databases?
faqs.a: Yes, our software systems provide API integration with major School Information Systems (SIS) and active directory security protocols.

faqs.q: What payment options does Vault Electronics accept?
faqs.a: We accept Direct Bank Wire Transfers (RTGS/EFT), M-Pesa Paybill/Till, Cheques, and major Credit/Debit Cards.

faqs.q: Do you offer delivery outside Nairobi or across East Africa?
faqs.a: Yes, we deliver and perform installations across all 47 counties in Kenya as well as neighboring East African countries (Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda).

faqs.q: Are tax-exempt purchasing options available for registered non-profits or diplomatic missions?
faqs.a: Yes, we process tax-exempt purchases upon provision of valid exemption certificates and issue fully compliant KRA E-TIMS tax invoices.

faqs.q: Can schools or corporate entities pay in installments?
faqs.a: We offer tailored payment milestones for institutional projects and partner with financial asset-leasing firms for long-term hardware leasing options.

faqs.q: What should I do if the screen touch stops responding?
faqs.a: Unplug the USB touch cable from the host computer and reconnect it. If using the embedded Android OS, restart the panel using the power button.

faqs.q: Why is there no sound coming from the screen speakers?
faqs.a: Check that the source device audio output is set to 'Vault Display / HDMI Audio' and verify that neither the panel nor source device is muted.

faqs.q: How do I update the screen's internal Android firmware?
faqs.a: Connect the display to Wi-Fi/Ethernet, go to Settings > System > System Update, and tap 'Check for OTA Update'.

faqs.q: How can I connect my MacBook to the panel?
faqs.a: Connect your MacBook using a single USB-C cable (supporting DisplayPort output) or via HDMI + USB touch cable. Alternatively, use native AirPlay for wireless connection.

faqs.q: What should I do if the image looks blurry on the screen?
faqs.a: Ensure your computer's output resolution is set to 3840 x 2160 (4K) at a 60Hz refresh rate in your desktop display control panel.
